address: LF, Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok at Chao Phraya River, 300/1 Charoen Krung Road, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok, 10120, Thailand
bio: There is a luxurious feel to this lavish Cantonese restaurant that is a gorgeously designed space inside the equally stylish Four Seasons hotel. Expansive windows look out onto a reflective pool which comes to life at night with the illumination of contemporary artworks. The Cantonese chef brings a modern and creative approach to the cooking, as well as a Thai twist in places. The extensive menus include tasting and à la carte options, plus a dim sum selection at lunch....
